raw_snippet: Deepgram also announced today the acquisition of OfOne, an AI-native voice platform created for restaurants and the quick-service drive-thru market.
value_text: acquires OfOne (voice AI for restaurant drive-thrus); terms undisclosed
note: Deepgram -> OfOne: vertical voice-AI app for restaurant drive-thrus (anchors Deepgram for Restaurants). Ledger sweep of 28 Sep 2026.
